functions.name: join-call
functions.description: Request a recording bot to join a meeting URL. Recording and subsequent processing continue after this tool returns.

title.description: Optional meeting title; omission leaves it unspecified, while null and empty text are passed through distinctly.

meetingUrl.description: Meeting URL for the bot to join, such as a Zoom or Google Meet URL.

participants.description: Optional meeting participants; omission leaves metadata unspecified, null is explicit null, and an empty array supplies no participants.

name.description: Participant display name, if known; omission, null and empty text remain distinct.

email.description: Participant email, if known; omission, null and empty text remain distinct.

items.description: Optional name and email metadata for one meeting participant.

FunctionInput_glyphic_joincall.description: Meeting URL and optional meeting metadata for a recording bot request.

requested.description: The provider returned success for the bot-creation request; this does not establish meeting admission, recording completion or delivery of processed results.

FunctionOutput_glyphic_joincall.description: Acknowledgment of the recording bot request, not meeting admission or recording completion.

tags.instructions: Use this to have a bot join and record a meeting. Obtain the meeting URL and any optional meeting metadata from the user. The result acknowledges the request, not successful admission or a completed recording. Do not replay blindly: duplicate bots for the same URL are blocked within two minutes. Use `list-calls` and `get-call` later to find the processed recording.
